constraints: Apply pds-dark-contribution, optionally --compact or --delivered; import shared CSS.
Heading is h3; content and composition remain consumer-owned.
Slingshot nested legacy-card fixes stay in explicitly scoped compatibility rules.
verification: Regression-test all existing dark contribution surfaces.
accessibility: Preserve meaningful heading order, accessible link labels, and visible keyboard focus where interactive.
responsive: Check 1440px, 768px, and 390px; no document overflow. Consumer-specific layout remains local.
semantics: A case study needs a dark personal-contribution or delivered-work surface
use_when: A case study needs a dark personal-contribution or delivered-work surface
do_not_use_when: Ordinary narrative prose or a purely decorative dark card.
